blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The Office of the Presidential Adviser on Peace, Reconciliation and Unity (Opapru) and the Mindanao Development Authority (MinDA) vowed to help the newly established regular Bangsamoro government. The move is meant to sustain the gains of the peace process and accelerate socioeconomic development in the region. On Thursday, Nov. 12, Presidential Peace Adviser Mel Senen Sarmiento and MinDA Chairman Leo Tereso Magno paid a courtesy visit to Bangsamoro Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua and his Cabinet here. During the meeting, the Palace officials discussed priority concerns involving peace, justice and regional development. The topics included amnesty applications for former […]...
